fields.Name: T62 - Entity Form Related Records Member
fields.Description: Verifies a Member record form shows its related-records sections.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity grid — type 'Members' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the EXACT 'Members' match (not 'Board Members'/'Memberships'/etc.); if that is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Members. Then click a member row and click 'Open Full Record'. The Member form has MANY related-records sections (Memberships, Event Registrations, Invoices, Certifications, Enrollments, etc.). Scroll down the form to the related-records area and open/expand ANY ONE related section; verify it displays that member's related rows (or a valid empty-state). Opening any one related section satisfies the goal — you do NOT need a specific one. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Member record full form is open
At least one related-records section is shown with related rows or a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
